name: get_articles
description: Get trending or recent DEV.to articles, optionally filtered by tag (e.g., "javascript", "react"). Returns title, author, reaction count, comments, reading time, and URL.

top.description: Return top articles from the last N days (e.g., 7 for last week)

limit.description: Number of articles to return (default 10, max 30)

name: search_articles
description: Search DEV.to articles by tag with pagination support. Returns title, author, tags, reactions, comments, reading time, and URL for each result.

limit.description: Number of articles per page (default 10, max 30)

name: get_article
description: Fetch full article content from DEV.to by ID (e.g., "12345"). Returns title, author, markdown body, tags, reactions, comments, and published date.
